# Project instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before working in this repository. It contains the
shared agent guidance, active-feature discovery steps, and Spec Kit skill workflow.

Read the [project constitution](../.specify/memory/constitution.md) and the relevant feature
artifacts before making changes. Read the applicable `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md` before
running a Spec Kit workflow. Keep shared guidance in `AGENTS.md` to avoid divergence.
